additional_info.subject: Problems with converters when activating a charging station- 170000902
additional_info.body:
Hello Team,
Yesterday we performed an activation (commission) for charging station 170000902
After activating a charging station, we got an error for 8 converters (all converters in charging station).
Charging station is currently not electrified but I am attaching the logs from the SCB.
I am attaching the order file for a charging station; it is important for me to note that a charging station is not under warranty.
But if it's 8 faulty converters, it's a very serious problem.
On top of that I am attaching the information that the charging station had to undergo a coolant test, we received a document from Siemens to check the coolant pipes, and this was checked by me am attaching pictures from the test.
We really ask that you help us provide a solution. 8 converters in one charging station, this could hurt our business.
Another important thing: just during the last month, 6 converters were replaced in charging stations (so it may be a faulty series)
Br,
Orel.

additional_info.body:
Dear Orel,
Thank you for reaching out to eMobility Support. My name is
Francisco
, and I will be assisting you with your following query today:
Product
: Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset
:
MP / P9 170000902
ChargerID/Serial No.
:
wcDgon
Problem Description
: PowerConverter errors
Troubleshooting
:
How long has the charger been in the warehouse without any power? I see that this charger has been delivered 2 years ago.
The requirements for the converters is that they need to supply current at least once per year. This might the case where it was left without power for too long.
This charger is out of warranty so customer must take the costs or as you wish to align with him.
From our side, if you confirm that the charger has not been powered for more than 1 year it's clear for me that they need replacement.
All this information that I shared with you was shared to me by Warranty Manager so they will reply the same to you.
For future reference, your ticket number is
0394913
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Francisco de Matos Joaquim
